app.previewNotice: Interface preview — files, downloads and results are simulated.
app.name: Syllentra

startup.desktopRequired: Open Syllentra to transcribe recordings on your computer.
startup.failed: Your workspace could not be opened.

transcript.noSpeechHint: Processing finished without detecting speech. No empty output files were created.

batch.title: Batch transcription
batch.intro: Transcribe audio and video files on your computer.
batch.emptyHint: Add audio, video, or an entire folder. You can choose exactly what to transcribe.
batch.keyboardHint: Space to include · Enter to preview · Arrow keys to navigate
batch.importCancelled_one: Import stopped · {{count}} recording found. Some folders may not have been scanned.
batch.importCancelled_other: Import stopped · {{count}} recordings found. Some folders may not have been scanned.
batch.importSummary: Last import: {{ignored}} unsupported or unavailable entries · {{duplicates}} duplicates ignored
batch.includeAudioLanguage: Include audio language in subtitle filenames
batch.includeAudioLanguageHint: Adds the selected audio track’s language code to SRT and VTT filenames when available.
batch.besideHint: Each transcript is saved next to its original recording.
batch.hierarchyHint: Imported folder names and subfolders are preserved.
batch.previewEmpty: Select a recording to inspect its details. Your transcript appears here when it’s ready.
batch.previewPending: The read-only transcript will appear here after this recording is processed.
batch.previewFailed: The session preview could not be opened.
batch.retryExportHint: Your transcript is retained for this session. Retry failed files to save the missing outputs without transcribing again.
batch.setupHint: Download Phonon-2.5 Multilingual once (156 MB). After setup, recordings are transcribed offline.
batch.prepareFirst: Prepare the speech model above before starting.
batch.modelAbout: Recognizes 25 European languages automatically, entirely on your computer. Japanese is not supported. Weights by Fermion Research, derived from NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, licensed under CC-BY-4.0.
batch.preferencesUnreadable: Saved preferences could not be read. Default interface settings are in use; the original file is preserved.
batch.conflictIntro: Choose one action per recording for all its existing outputs. Missing formats are still generated. Rename creates a new complete format set.
batch.renameHint: Rename keeps all formats for a recording together, using the same numbered filename. No recording is overwritten.
batch.conflictsChecked: Existing outputs are checked before processing begins.
batch.discardHint: Some transcripts could not be exported. Starting a new batch clears these session previews. Recordings and files already exported are kept.
batch.quitHint: Active work will stop and queued recordings will be cancelled. Session previews with unsaved outputs will be lost. Files already exported are kept.

failure.source: The source recording changed or is unavailable.
failure.model: The speech model could not be loaded.
failure.inference: This recording could not be transcribed.
failure.export: Some output files could not be saved.

commandError.invalid_request: This action could not be completed. Review the details and try again.
commandError.unavailable: The file or folder is unavailable. Check its location and permissions.
commandError.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish or cancel it first.
commandError.unexpected: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

batch.selectionHelp: Adding files, folders, or drops extends this list. Checkboxes choose what runs. New batch starts an empty list and resets export choices; your files and saved transcripts stay on disk.
batch.modelStorageHelp: Download or import a verified copy of Phonon-2.5 into the portable model folder.
batch.portableHelp: Move Syllentra Data together with the application to keep your model and settings.
batch.newBatchHint: Start an empty batch and reset export choices. Source files and saved transcripts are preserved.
batch.fileProgressHint: Based on audio transcribed in the current file. Updates after each audio segment. Loading the model and preparing audio have no transcription percentage.
batch.supportedLanguagesHint: Automatic recognition applies to these languages. The list comes from the active engine.
batch.batchProgressHint: Based on finished files, including completed, skipped, failed and cancelled files. File duration does not affect this percentage.
batch.setupProgressHint: Download and preparation may take a few minutes.

audio.preferenceHint: Applies only to files with multiple audio tracks. If no language match is found, the default or first track is used. Your choice is remembered.
audio.unavailableCount: {{count}} could not be inspected; audio will be checked during processing.

reason.single: Only audio track; the language preference does not apply.
reason.preferred: Selected by your preferred audio language.
reason.default: Using the file default or first audio track.
reason.fallback: Preferred language unavailable or unknown; using the default or first audio track.
reason.unavailable: Audio tracks could not be inspected. This file will be checked during processing.

audio.activePreference: Prefer {{language}} in files with multiple audio tracks. Files with one track use that track.
audio.noPreference: No language preference is set. Files with multiple audio tracks use their default or first track.

groups.singleHint: These files have only one audio track. It will be transcribed regardless of the language preference.
groups.preferredHint: These files have a track identified as {{language}}. Dialogue is preferred; matching default tracks take priority, otherwise the first match is used.
groups.defaultHint: No language preference is set. These files use their marked default audio track, or their first audio track if none is marked.
groups.fallbackHint: Files without a track identified as {{language}} use their marked default audio track, or their first audio track if none is marked.
groups.manualHint: Files with a track you selected individually appear here. Choose “Automatic (batch preference)” in File details to restore automatic selection.
groups.preferredUnsetHint: Set a preferred audio language in Settings. Files with a matching track will appear here.
